main_text.p: REPETITVRVM, cum negatione legendum esse: ut sit, VTIQVE NON REPETITVRVM. quomodo nostri locis innumeris locuti sunt. Alioqui quorsum obsecro tam longa ista exemplorum enumeratio pertinet? quibus Africanus demonstrat, naturalem obligationem etiam post migrationem de familia permanere: sola eam peculij participatione retentioneue restingui: ubi nulla participatio retentionis est, ibi eam uim efficientiamque suam in integram & incolumem retinere. Aut vero, quid tandem illud est, quod idem Africanus in disceptanda secunda controuersia inter patrem & filium, ijsdem prope verbis ac syllabis affirmat, filium, qui emancipatus soluit, si peculium suum integrum a patre acceperit, nihil repetiturum? Consideremus, quae sit istarum controuersiarum similitudo. In hac controuersia frater fratri, quum in eadem essent familia, credidit: in illa, pater filiofamilias. In hac, patris morte sui iuris factus filius, fratri dissoluit: in illa, patris beneficio emancipatus filius patri satisfecit. Quo igitur eadem, aut certe

page.notes: Running head and page number partly covered by an ink stamp; the bracketed parts are unreadable. Line-end breaks "pecu/lij" and "restin/gui" have no printed hyphen visible, so the words are written whole; "restingui" is uncertain. "fuam" in the scan is read as suam (long s), marked as doubtful in the text. The reading "retentionis" is a guess at a partly printed word, and "ijsdem" is read from a close-set line. The letters "y s" below the text are taken as the gathering signature. "repetitu-rum" is printed with a colon after it, and the printer's punctuation is kept as "repetiturum?" only where the scan shows a question mark; otherwise it is uncertain.
